x: Paul begun 1990 with an impressive 2nd place in the New Year's Day Morpeth to Newcastle road race, just behind Paul Cuskin, but claiming the scalps of Steve Jones, Steve Brace and Geoff Wightman amongst others.

Paul had come second to Paul Cuskin in 1990, and was 4th last year. This year he was determined to make it third time lucky and showed his strength with a 4:34 tenth mile which left the rest of the field in his wake.
Steve Halliday tussled for the lead early on but had to give way finally to Valli's Paul Cuskin, who relieved our man of his course record by clocking 30:36, and Skyrac's Peter Whitehead.
